title: Cost Glance Overlay — interaction refinements & stakeholder review
creator: Mariana Soto
description: Design and finalize the ‘Cost Glance’ overlay: a compact, route-aware overlay that surfaces per-route cost and latency signals directly on the dashboard tiles. Deliverables: Figma prototype with motion specs, accessibility contrast and keyboard interactions, redlines for dev handoff, QA checklist, and rollout guidance for feature flags.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates enter/exit overlay motion and keyboard focus flow
Contrast and color choices meet WCAG AA for text and WCAG AAA where possible for critical values
Dev redlines include responsive variants for density modes and small-screen truncation rules
QA checklist covers animation timings, token-count badge updates, and ARIA announcements
comments: 2026-02-11 — Mariana Soto: Initial kickoff with PM + Eng. Aligned on goals: surface top-3 cost signals per route, avoid cluttering tile, and preserve tile-level click target. Decided overlay should be ephemeral (hover / focus / explicit expand).

2026-02-18 — Lena Park: First low-fi flows uploaded. Two variants: ‘peek’ (small hover card) and ‘panel’ (expanded overlay anchored to tile). Request from PM to prioritize ‘peek’ for density mode. Added motion intent notes.

2026-02-22 — Jonah Patel (PM): PM feedback — prefer peek as default but keep panel for power users (keyboard shortcut). Add quick link to route-level cost breakdown report. Also asked for guidance on feature flag gating for Dedicated customers.

2026-02-26 — Eng (Ruth Chen): Feasibility note — peek is straightforward, but we need explicit aria-live region for screen readers to announce overlay content. Also raised concerns about tooltip z-index and virtualization in long lists.

2026-03-02 — Mariana Soto: Updated Figma with motion frames (0ms -> 120ms ease-out for enter, 80ms ease-in for exit). Documented token rollover behavior and how token-count badges should update while overlay is open.

2026-03-04 — Accessibility review (external): Keyboard testing found two issues: focus trap on panel variant and insufficient color contrast for secondary metric chips. Proposed fixes included stronger token chip color and explicit focus outline.
2026-03-06 — Lena Park: Applied a11y fixes and produced dev redlines PDF. Added responsive notes: on narrow screens the overlay becomes a full-width bottom sheet (to avoid off-screen clipping).

2026-03-08 — QA (Samir Gupta): Draft QA checklist added. Key tests: hover activation, keyboard shortcut to open panel, screen reader announcements, visual regression on density mode toggles, telemetry event emitted on expand/collapse. Reported flaky hover on Safari — added cross-browser test ticket ENG-41789.

2026-03-10 — PM (Jonah Patel): Stakeholder review: design approved with one exception — product requested option to pin overlay for multi-tile comparisons (low priority). Added a follow-up ticket in backlog.
2026-03-12 — Lena Park: Final design handoff ready. Uploaded redlines, motion tokens, and QA checklist. Next: handoff meeting scheduled with Eng and QA for 2026-03-15.
dev_notes: Prefer CSS transform + opacity for enter/exit transitions to avoid layout jank
Expose a small API for metrics population so backend can toggle displayed metrics per-customer tier
ARIA: use aria-expanded on the tile button, aria-describedby for metric detail, and an offscreen live region for announcements
Telemetry events: overlay_open, overlay_close, overlay_pin, overlay_view_metric (include route_id and model_id)
handoff_items: Redlines PDF (annotated sizes, spacing, color tokens)
Responsive breakpoints and bottom-sheet behaviour for small screens
next_steps: 03/15 — Handoff review meeting with ENG & QA (owner: Lena)
03/18 — ENG to open implementation epic and spike on virtualization edge-cases (owner: Ruth)
03/22 — QA to run cross-browser pre-merge tests and validate animations (owner: Samir)
